choice_rows.label: Item 13 — Availing of tax relief under a Special Law / International Tax Treaty?

validation.how: Errors render in a 'Needs review' list after all sections (`body.child(section("Needs review", issues, cx))`); only the label turns red, and only when an error key equals an input key (email, surcharge, interest, compromise).

findings.now: Schedules A and B show five fixed rows with no add control, so a donor with a sixth item cannot enter it.
findings.why: The official form grows both schedules (11 indexed families) and the model caps them at five (form_1800.rs:35, 549-554), so the omission is silent and the donor tax is understated.

options.name: Add row button
options.detail: Append rows on demand and splice them into the layout after row five, as the 1801 Part V tables are meant to work.

options.name: Per-row delete
options.detail: Use the official chkScheduleADelete and chkScheduleB pattern so a row can be removed as well as added.

options.name: Warn before typing
options.detail: Show a 'more than five items: file the rest with the RDO' notice beside the schedules.

findings.now: The typed e-mail is written in upper case into the uploaded XML and into the Print preview.
findings.why: The email must never be upper-cased, official_inputs.rs:147-149 says capital() skips txtEmail, and form_2000.rs:1004 writes the typed value.

options.name: Write as typed
options.detail: Set txtEmail to the trimmed text the filer typed, as form_2000.rs:1004 does.

options.name: Exclude from the upper-case pass
options.detail: Keep up() for the other text controls and skip txtEmail, matching the documented capital() behaviour.

options.name: Record a reviewed exception
options.detail: If the official HTA really uppercases txtEmail, document that as an exception while the displayed value stays as typed.

findings.now: Any amount in Items 28–32, or net gifts under P250,000, leaves Queue for submission disabled under Needs review, and nothing on the page warns before the figures are typed.
findings.why: The port refuses these returns instead of filing the official negative tax or a deduction Item 33 never carries, so donors in these cases cannot file in the app.

options.name: Warn at entry
options.detail: Show a note beside Item 36 and the deduction rows when the exemption or deduction rule applies.

options.name: Route to RDO
options.detail: Replace the generic Needs review text with a 'file this return with the RDO' banner that states the reason.

options.name: Floor at zero after review
options.detail: Only once the official behaviour is confirmed, allow zero tax due and keep the official figure in the XML.

findings.now: The name alert reads 'Item 8' under the field labelled 'Item 7 — Donor's name', the RDO alert reads 'Item 5' under 'Item 6 — RDO code', and the empty-TIN alert reads 'Item 4', which is the ATC line.
findings.why: The alerts are verbatim official text, but the on-page numbering differs, so the filer is sent to the wrong line.

options.name: Pointer after the alert
options.detail: Keep the verbatim text and add the on-page label, for example '(Item 7 on this page)'.

options.name: Link alert to field
options.detail: Make each Needs review line clickable so it scrolls to and focuses its input.

options.name: Relabel to the paper form
options.detail: Align the page labels with the item numbers the alerts cite, after checking the printed form.

findings.now: Errors for the TIN, RDO, donation date, donor name, treaty and donees leave their labels black, so the filer finds them only in the Needs review list.
findings.why: has_error matches only keys equal to an input key (event_form_kit.rs:154-163), and these error keys (rdo_code, donation_date, donor_name, tax_relief, donees) differ from the input keys (rdo, month, name, relief).

options.name: Map keys to inputs
options.detail: Report each error under its editor key, for example 'rdo' for rdo_code, so has_error matches.

options.name: Message beside field
options.detail: Render each message under its own input as well as in the list.

options.name: Focus first error
options.detail: Scroll to and focus the first failing input when Queue or Save is pressed.

findings.now: The TIN is shown as read-only text, yet the Needs review line tells the filer to enter a valid TIN on Item 4 or Item 5.
findings.why: The draft copies the profile TIN at creation (form_1800.rs:203) and load_draft never refreshes it (queueable_forms.rs:43-47), so a bad TIN blocks Queue with no fix on this page.

options.name: Editable TIN
options.detail: Let the filer correct the TIN on the draft, under the same checksum rule as the profile.

options.name: Refresh from profile
options.detail: Re-read the profile TIN when an editable draft opens.

options.name: Link to profile
options.detail: Replace the alert with a button that opens the taxpayer profile.

findings.now: A new return opens Item 1 with today's month and day and the tile's year, and the filer has to notice and change it.
findings.why: The donation date goes into the XML and the filename, so an unchanged default misdates the gift.

options.name: Blank until entered
options.detail: Start Item 1 empty and require a valid date before Queue.

options.name: Visible placeholder
options.detail: Default to 12/31 of the tile year and show it as a placeholder the filer must replace.

options.name: Confirm notice
options.detail: Keep today's date but show a 'confirm the donation date' line until Item 1 is edited.

findings.now: A clean check shows no confirmation, the official amended-return alert never appears, and the port shows 'Item 17C applies only to an amended return.' instead.
findings.why: Official alerts must appear verbatim and in order, and the port substitutes a non-official line for one of them.

options.name: Show the official success text
options.detail: Display 'Validation successful. Click on 'Edit' if you wish to modify your entries.' after a clean check.

options.name: Add the official amended alert
options.detail: Emit the save-009 text under its official condition and keep the Item 17C line only as an extra.

options.name: Remove the substitute
options.detail: Drop the non-official line once the official condition is ported.

findings.now: Commit c5b822e9, titled as a 1800 fix, also edits crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1706.rs at lines 9 and 666.
findings.why: Outside the form's own files only one-line registrations may change, and this edit touches another form's model.

options.name: Split the commit
options.detail: Move the 1706 lines into a separate 1706 commit so the 1800 change stays in its own files.

options.name: Revert the 1706 lines
options.detail: Restore form_1706.rs if the 1800 fix does not need them.

options.name: Keep with a note
options.detail: Keep the change and record it as an accepted shared fix in the review notes.
